findings.scenario: The unreleased P07.2 changelog says the legacy data column is unused, and packages/tenancy/README.md line 17 repeats that root_accounts.data is unused. ClaimAccountSignup still selects data->>'signup_key' and updates data with the signup payload, and PendingPool still filters on data->pool_cleanup and jsonb_sets that marker before DROP. An operator who follows the changelog and drops or stops writing the column before P08 loses signup idempotency and pending-cleanup recovery. D107 forbids that claim and keeps those SQL operations until the column moves in P08.

findings.scenario: config/tenancy.php is gone and TenancyServiceProvider merges only corex-tenancy, but axiomasoft/corex-tenancy.upstream_config is still ["tenancy"]. ownership-gate.php skips the O2 config-identifier check for that id, so restoring a tenancy config file or mergeConfigFrom(..., 'tenancy') is exempt. D45 requires P07 to remove this exception together with the shared stancl key.
